risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially counterfeit, which reduces value significantly

risks.proof: Proof of manufacturing date or batch code from the box or battery label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially degraded, which reduces value

risks.risk: The seller may not have the other claimed products (solar panels, inverters) in stock.
risks.proof: Photos of the solar panels and inverters, or a video tour of the inventory.
risks.if_unproven: priced only for the visible batteries, with no value for unverified items

proof_requests: Photos of the solar panels and inverters mentioned in the listing.
